methodology.selected: Three alternating fresh-process pairs per host/mode at N=1111111. Explicit loaded-host lane records known CPU activity and rejects source changes or monitor errors. Intel also rejects pre-run active swap I/O. No idle-host speed claim.
methodology.timing: execute includes parsing, analysis and evaluation. Process startup and interpreter construction excluded. RSS is whole-process high-water mark.
methodology.full: One built-runtime process per mode on a loaded Intel host; separate source/Vitest compiled golden. These are correctness/full-scale observations, not a controlled full before/after series.
methodology.memoryPrimitive: Five million cells; 10 small warmups and GC before one call. Three fresh processes per variant/host. Native buffer allocation and RSS are the focus; timing/GC scheduling are workload-dependent.
